products.body_html:
Conquer the cold weather with the new heated handwarmer. Designed for comfort and practicality, it attaches securely to your buggy to ensure you can keep your hands warm and ready throughout your entire round.

Crafted from durable, high-quality material, it is built to withstand the coldest conditions while keeping you warm with a fleece-lined interior.

Compatible with the Zip Series, Ai Navigator GPS+, Ai 500. Not suitable for the Ai Navigator Halo.

*This product is available in selected countries.

products.title: Halo Eye
products.body_html:
Experience more with the Halo Eye. The Halo Eye is a 2D LiDAR sensor designed to capture precise spatial data from the environment to support real-time tracking, navigation and obstacle avoidance. When integrated with the MGI Ai Navigator Halo, it unlocks advanced functions to enhance your on-course experience.

Unlock features such as:

  • Follow me
  • Return home
  • Point to point
  • Obstacle avoidance

* The Halo Eye is only compatible with the MGI Ai Navigator Halo.
Important: Remove the Halo Eye from the buggy before folding the buggy for transport or storage. Do not fold, transport or store the buggy with the Halo Eye installed.

products.title: MGI Pro-Play Golf Bag
products.body_html:
Introducing the MGI Pro-Play Golf Bag. Crafted for quality, this bag delivers a streamlined, professional experience so you can focus on your next shot. Constructed from high-quality, lightweight materials, this bag ensures to offer exceptional durability.

Featuring innovative BagLink technology to lock your bag onto any MGI Ai, Zip or E Series models, and 14 full-length divider including a separate Putter Well, the MGI Pro-Play Bag integrates seamlessly into your golf setup.

Available in Black/Grey

products.title: MGI Ai Navigator Halo
products.body_html:
RRP AU $3,249

Step into the future of golf with the MGI Ai Navigator Halo, the next evolution in intelligent, remote-controlled play. It combines cutting-edge GPS capability and our next-gen remote to ensure you can make confident choices, every hole.

With advanced Geo Protect technology using mapped hazards, the Ai Navigator Halo delivers truly smart navigation. Powerful brushless in-hub motors drive each wheel independently for smooth performance, while the improved 5th wheel adds reliable stability on any terrain. With Gyroscope Straight Tracker technology and downhill speed, you can ensure your game stays perfectly on course.

Off the course, the enhanced fold design makes pack-down and storage simple. The new innovative compact fold means this model is easier to store than ever before.

Take your Ai Navigator Halo experience further with the Halo Eye. Featuring intelligent tracking technology that works seamlessly with your Ai Navigator Halo, the Halo Eye gives you another way to move around the course while keeping your caddy close by.

Did you know Ai Navigator Halo can pair with the MGI SureShot SlimPRO Laser Rangefinder? Connect your tech for a smarter, more seamless round. Get your distances fast and stay focused on the shot ahead.

products.body_html:

Easy to pour and refill, the Sand Bottle works with both sand and seed, making any round of golf seamless and convenient.

Ensure you choose the correct Sand Bottle Holder for your respective buggy.

products.title: MGI E-Boost Golf Pushcart
products.body_html:
RRP AU $899

Introducing the E-BOOST, a first-of-its-kind pushcart with a kick. It’s a classic, lightweight golf pushcart that provides an extra boost at the press of a button through its hidden motor. Perfect for golfers who love a classic feel, but still want an effortless advantage.

Whether you’re tackling steep hills, battling fatigue or pushing through a long round, the E-BOOST has your back. Enjoy effortless movement by seamlessly switching between Push and Boost mode to enhance your performance.

Enjoy effortless navigation with a full directional remote, allowing you to control the buggy from over 100 metres away. The MGI App is available for iOS and Android devices.
